name: I Am Mad Newton
summary:
Step into I Am Mad Newton, a wild VR Newton physics playground where every Newton experiment can turn into chaos. In I Am Mad Newton, become a mad scientist and explore a hands-on Newton sandbox filled with physics, gravity, chemistry, ragdolls and interactive machines.
